mode.title: Output Mode
mode.description: How this row writes data to OneDrive/SharePoint — upload files as-is, write a table as CSV, or write a table into an Excel worksheet.

helper_account_type.title: Helper Account Type
helper_account_type.description: Hidden helper: mirrors the root configuration's account.account_type so sibling fields below can depend on it (a row schema cannot reference the root config directly).

drive_id.title: Document Library
drive_id.description: Target document library (drive) for the upload

options.tooltip: Only applies to SharePoint accounts with more than one library. Leave empty to use the site's default document library.

folder_path.title: Folder Path
folder_path.description: Folder inside the library; missing folders are created automatically

options.tooltip: Relative to the library root. Supports strftime-style date placeholders, e.g. reports/{date:%Y-%m-%d} — resolved at run start (UTC) by default, or use the Date field below (e.g. set Date to 'yesterday') to write into a different day's folder.

date.title: Date
date.description: Date used by the {date:...} placeholders in Folder Path

options.tooltip: Accepts a relative expression (yesterday, 3 days ago, last week) or an absolute date (2026-01-31). Leave empty to default to the job's start date (UTC).

conflict_behavior.title: Conflict Behavior
conflict_behavior.description: What to do when a file with the same name already exists

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: Name of the uploaded CSV file

options.tooltip: Defaults to the input table's name with a .csv extension when left empty.

include_header.title: Include Header
include_header.description: Include the column header row in the uploaded file

path.title: Workbook Path
path.description: Path to the target workbook; created automatically when missing

options.tooltip: Accepts a library-relative path (/Reports/data.xlsx), drive://{driveId}/path, site://{siteName}/path, or an https:// sharing link. Use the search sync action to check whether it already exists. Leave empty and use the Library + Workbook pickers below instead.

drive_id.title: Library
drive_id.description: Advanced targeting: document library of an existing workbook

options.tooltip: Pick the document library that contains the workbook, then pick the workbook itself below — never combine with Path. For Private OneDrive/OneDrive for Business accounts this is always the account's own default drive.

file_id.title: Workbook
file_id.description: Advanced targeting: an existing workbook in the selected library

options.tooltip: Lists the XLSX files found in the Library selected above — never combine with Path.

name.title: Worksheet Name
name.description: Name of the target worksheet; created if it doesn't exist

options.tooltip: Provide alone to select or create a worksheet by name. Combine with ID or Position to rename that worksheet to this name.

id.title: Worksheet ID
id.description: Advanced targeting: an existing worksheet in the workbook configured above

options.tooltip: Lists the worksheets found in the Workbook configured above (Path, or Library + Workbook). Mutually exclusive with Position — set only one of the two. Combine with Name to rename the worksheet.

position.title: Worksheet Position
position.description: Advanced targeting: zero-based worksheet tab position

options.tooltip: Mutually exclusive with ID — set only one of the two. Combine with Name to rename the worksheet.

append.title: Append
append.description: Append rows below existing data instead of clearing and overwriting the worksheet

batch_size.title: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Number of rows written per Excel API request
